description: This file defines the DataCell class, a custom Swing JLabel component used within a table for displaying and interacting with data cells, including features like value evaluation, color coding, and user interaction handling.

classes.name: DataCell
classes.description: A custom Swing JLabel component that displays data within a table, supporting features like value formatting, color coding based on data comparisons, selection/highlighting state management, and user interaction handling including mouse events.

methods.name: DataCell
methods.description: Constructor initializing a DataCell with reference to parent table and optional static text.

methods.name: getBinValue
methods.description: Returns the binary (raw) value of the cell.

methods.name: getRealValue
methods.description: Evaluates and returns the real (scaled) value of the cell based on current scale expression.

methods.name: setRealValue
methods.description: Parses input string, evaluates the expression, and sets the cell's bin value accordingly.

methods.name: getCompareValue
methods.description: Returns the difference between the bin value and the comparison value.

methods.name: getRealCompareValue
methods.description: Calculates and returns the difference in real (scaled) values for comparison.

methods.name: getRealCompareChangeValue
methods.description: Calculates and returns the relative change between real values for comparison.

methods.name: getCompareColor
methods.description: Returns the color representing the comparison status of the cell.

methods.name: getBinColor
methods.description: Returns the color representing the bin value of the cell.

methods.name: drawCell
methods.description: Updates the visual representation of the cell based on current state and data.

methods.name: getCellBackgroundColor
methods.description: Determines background color based on selection, highlighting, or data comparison.

methods.name: getCellTextColor
methods.description: Determines text color based on tracing and UI state.

methods.name: getCellBorder
methods.description: Determines border style based on trace status and value changes.

methods.name: getCellText
methods.description: Generates the text to display in the cell based on current data and scale.

methods.name: getCellToolTip
methods.description: Returns tooltip text for the cell, usually the evaluated real value.

methods.name: getLiveValue
methods.description: Returns the live value string associated with the cell.

methods.name: getLiveValueString
methods.description: Formats the live value string for display.

methods.name: setBinValue
methods.description: Sets the binary value of the cell, ensuring it is within allowed range, then redraws.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the cell's display text.

methods.name: isSelected
methods.description: Checks if the cell is selected.

methods.name: setSelected
methods.description: Sets the selected state and redraws if changed.

methods.name: setHighlighted
methods.description: Sets the highlighted state and redraws if changed.

methods.name: isHighlighted
methods.description: Checks if the cell is highlighted.

methods.name: mouseEntered
methods.description: Handles mouse enter events, highlighting or clearing based on modifiers.

methods.name: mousePressed
methods.description: Handles mouse press events, managing selection and highlight states.

methods.name: mouseReleased
methods.description: Resets highlight state on mouse release.

methods.name: mouseClicked
methods.description: Empty mouse click handler.

methods.name: mouseExited
methods.description: Empty mouse exit handler.

methods.name: clearCell
methods.description: Clears highlight and selection states.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Adjusts the cell value by a specified increment, respecting scale and storage type.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Restores the original value.

methods.name: setRevertPoint
methods.description: Sets the current bin value as the revert point.

methods.name: setOriginalValue
methods.description: Sets the original value.

methods.name: setCompareValue
methods.description: Sets the comparison value based on another DataCell.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Multiplies the bin value by a factor.

methods.name: setLiveDataTrace
methods.description: Enables or disables live data tracing.

methods.name: setLiveDataTraceValue
methods.description: Sets the live data trace string.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Retrieves application settings from the SettingsManager.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on table static status and bin value.

methods.name: getStaticText
methods.description: Returns static text displayed in static data tables.

methods.name: setY
methods.description: Sets the y-coordinate (used in UI layout).
